text:
ash: alert — large uptick in orphaned traces right after the quota rollout (v2) at 09:00 UTC. parents exist but child spans missing for ~80% of alpha-prod requests :red_flag:
katie: ugh. is this only alpha-prod or across tenants?
siddharth: initial check — looks concentrated to alpha-prod and beta-staging small spike. i can pull exporter logs.
ash: infra-bot ran a quick scan — exporting summary: exporter-http-1 returned 429s starting at 09:02 UTC, backlog grew, sampler fallback triggered for a short window.
infra-bot: detected: exporter=http://exporter.region1.redwood/otlp status=429 rate_limit_reason=quota_exceeded tenant=alpha-prod spike_count=312 start=2024-11-07T09:02:14Z
nate: can someone paste the sample header we use? worried the sampler override header got stripped by the quota proxy.
lina: header is X-Redwood-Sample with value=0.0/1.0 mix. our rollout added a quota proxy that rewrites headers for routing.
katie: if the proxy stripped X-Redwood-Sample, child spans might be sampled out while parent persisted — causes orphan parents.
siddharth: i pulled a trace dump. sample: parent span has traceparent intact, children absent. exporter logs show 'unfinished-batch dropped due to ack timeout' around same time.
nash: quick mitigation idea: disable the quota-proxy rewrite for alpha-prod for 30m and failover to secondary exporter region2.
lina: can we do a safer config? toggle 'preserve-sampling-headers=true' on proxy via k8s rollout patch. low-risk.
katie: +1 on preserving headers. also increase exporter retries/backoff jitter to avoid immediate 429 surge.
siddharth: command I used to find headers from proxy logs: 
```
kubectl logs -l app=quota-proxy -n infra | grep "tenant=alpha-prod" | tail -n 50 | jq -r '.headers["X-Redwood-Sample"]' | sort | uniq -c
```
result: most lines returned null between 09:02-09:12. earlier windows had values.
nate: rolling preserve-sampling-headers now (patching configmap) and bumping exporter retry-policy to retries=5 backoff=200ms.
nash: i'm also flipping route fallback to region2 for alpha-prod in the routing policy to drain region1 exporter. command: `rbacctl set-route alpha-prod --fallback=region2 --commit`
katie: after toggles, are we seeing child spans reappearing?
infra-bot: metric: orphaned_traces_ratio{tenant="alpha-prod"} dropped from 0.82 to 0.12 within 7m of patch. exporter-429s decreased.
siddharth: verified a few traces — children are back. still want full postmortem: root cause seems to be quota-proxy rewrite combined with aggressive quota enforcement ramp in rollout v2.
lina: action items: 1) revert rewrite in rollout and add preserve-sampling-headers=true 2) add canary throttle for quota ramp so exporter 429s don't surge 3) add dashboard panel for orphaned_traces_ratio and exporter_429_rate 4) implement automatic fallback to secondary exporter on 5xx/429 spikes
nate: logging ticket created: infra/7258 (quota-proxy: preserve headers + canary ramp).
katie: thanks all. i'll follow up with a short note for product about the rollout gating. :thumbsup:
nash: will open postmortem doc and link time series + examples. good catch by infra-bot.
infra-bot: incident closed (temporary mitigation applied).
